optimization: Release; -O3 -DNDEBUG; C++17; deployment target 15.0; macOS SDK 27.0

method.workload: empty window; no images or background decode; default per-app geometry (qView normal, Fovelle maximized)
method.settings: fresh temporary INI per process; qView firstlaunch=true to suppress Welcome; Fovelle normal migration retained
method.online_updates: qView compiled out; Fovelle disabled via build and environment
method.cache: one warmup per app, no purge of system file caches; new process each sample
method.startup: parent monotonic timestamp before Popen to both first event loop AND menu readiness
method.exit: pre-quit marker receipt to process fully reaped; app.quit uses normal Qt path
limitations: Different default window sizes and feature sets
qView is a source build with a main.cpp-only measurement patch, not the shipped Qt 6.8.3 bundle
Fresh profile migration and suppressed onboarding are explicit workload choices
These results do not cover image decode, pending workers, saved profiles, cold OS cache, Finder launch or all hardware
method.matched_window_sensitivity: Second independent 20-pair batch with FOVELLE_BENCH_MAXIMIZED=1: qView uses the same new MainWindow / setWindowState(Maximized) / show / raise sequence as Fovelle; original qView default geometry batch retained.
method.interpretation: The inherited compare.py passed flag tests the earlier 50% goal. It is not a validity flag: every measured process exited 0, and all readiness/quit markers were required.
